summary: Iter51 verified three new features: (1) Bulk student Excel import (template, preview, commit, re-import idempotence, RBAC, cleanup); (2) Teacher monthly attendance recap endpoint + UI (admin tab + kepsek default landing); (3) Vortex Guard live-proctor violation alerts (banner, flashing tile data-flash='1', pelanggaran-baru badge, sound toggle, clear). Backend: 16/16 passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter51_import_teacher_proctor.py (JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter51.xml). Frontend: Playwright smoke of /accounts import modal (800 ok / 1 error / password default siswa2026@ / filters / show-more / result count '800 akun dibuat'), /teacher-attendance monthly tab + prev/next month navigation, kepsek-role default-to-monthly, and live-proctor alert flow all green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: GET /api/users seems to ignore the `kelas` query parameter in the current contract (returns all siswa regardless). Not blocking (frontend filters client-side), but should either honor it server-side (perf for 3000+ siswa) or drop it from the docs/UI examples.
Import flow re-hashes bcrypt only once (hash_pw(pw) reused for all 800 rows) which is why 800 users import in <5s. Good design, worth documenting as intentional.
server.py is now 6742 lines; splitting Import (lines 6569-6727), Teacher-Monthly (6517-6567), Vortex (2267-2600) into submodules remains a strong recommendation (carried forward from iter50).

ImportStudentsModal.jsx 'Baris 802 - Duplikat' summary shows multiple comma-joined errors on one line (NISN wajib..., Nomor WA..., Email duplikat). Acceptable but a bulleted list might improve readability for admins.
LiveProctor flash state TTL is 15s hard-coded; consider exposing a prop or constant so future a11y/sound tweaks are easier.
